title: ADR-0017: Unified Project Hooks
rationale: Two mechanisms for Project entry points (manifest checkables + module functions) is unjustified. One mechanism — Dagger module functions — is simpler, more expressive, and follows the everything-is-Dagger-code paradigm.

title: dagmar-624c: Go port/adapter layer removed — Project Hook Services are Dagger functions
rationale: Env.WithMainModule() registers hook functions natively as LLM tools; conformance via Dagger introspection (Module.Functions()); Tier-B abstraction = Dagger function name, not Go interface. Tracer/Span retained (observability, not a Project Hook Service). dagmar-bootstrap/dagmar-gate untouched (programmatic hooks). os-eco term replaced by Project Hook Services everywhere. Next: dagmar-2cc8 (ADR-0018 code cleanup), then dagmar-c712 (ADR-0019 hook signatures + introspection conformance, blocked by 2cc8).

name: Dagger v0.21.8 LLM Env: Privileged + Writable + Input/Output bindings (cognition proof)
description: EMPIRICALLY PROVEN 2026-08-09: The correct Env setup for dag.LLM().Loop() in v0.21.8 requires EnvOpts{Privileged: true, Writable: true} + WithDirectoryInput('source', dir) + WithDirectoryOutput('result'). Without Privileged, the LLM only sees DeclareOutput + ReadLogs (no file tools). Without Writable, the LLM cannot Save outputs. The workspace via WithWorkspace alone is insufficient — the LLM cannot write files to it. The agent reads from the 'source' input binding, modifies via Directory.withNewFile, and Saves the result to the 'result' output binding. After Loop, read env.Output('result').AsDirectory(). The CLI flag for MaxAPICalls is --max-apicalls (kebab-cased from maxAPICalls, NOT --max-api-calls). Proven via dagger call -m .dagger code --source . --prompt-file <md> --model claude-sonnet-4-20250514 --max-apicalls 15 --module-ref '' — agent successfully read README.md, created COGNITION_PROOF.txt, and saved the result.

SYMPTOM: dag.LLM().Loop() runs but the agent cannot read/write files — it only sees DeclareOutput + ReadLogs tools. CAUSE: Env was created without Privileged:true. Without Privileged, the LLM has no access to the core Dagger API (Directory, File, Container). Additionally, WithWorkspace(dir) alone does NOT provide file write tools — the workspace is read-only context. FIX: use EnvOpts{Privileged:true, Writable:true} + WithDirectoryInput('source', dir) + WithDirectoryOutput('result'). The agent reads from the input, modifies via Directory.withNewFile, and Saves to the output.
resolution: Fixed in code.go: Env now uses Privileged+Writable+Input/Output bindings instead of WithWorkspace. Proven end-to-end.

title: ADR-0022: Env construction for the LLM Loop — Privileged/Writable/IO bindings
rationale: The cognition proof (dagmar-9571) empirically showed that EnvOpts{Privileged:true} is MANDATORY for file tool access; Without it the LLM sees only DeclareOutput+ReadLogs. WithWorkspace alone does not provide write access — must use WithDirectoryInput/Output. ADR-0022 documents the proven pattern + reconciles the Privileged vs hermeticity tension (ADR-0011).

title: ADR-0023: Prompter-LLM replaces canopy cross-store merge
rationale: ADR-0005's mechanical canopy merge (cn/bun in every agent pod) is superseded by a dedicated Prompter-LLM that reads project context (source + dagmar-issues + dagmar-memory) and synthesizes task-specific prompts guided by static go:embed meta-prompts. Adjudicator replaces Calibration Agent. dagmar-prompt hook removed. Prompt CRD removed. Pipeline: prompt→code→gate→review→adjudicate.

name: Coverage-ratcheting gate: basis-point floor in Project CRD + Go coverage check
description: dagmar-4154: Coverage-ratcheting implemented. CoveragePolicy in Project CRD Spec (Enabled, MinimumFloor, RatchetMargin — all in basis points 0-10000 to avoid float64 in CRD). CoverageFloor in Project CRD Status (controller-managed, ratcheted). Gate function (.dagmar/internal/workflows/gate.go) gains coverageFloorBps param: runs go test -coverprofile + go tool cover -func, compares total coverage against floor, gate RED if below. Controller annotates coder Sub-Run with floor via dagmar.denkhaus.io/coverage-floor annotation; agent pod passes --coverage-floor-bps to dagger call dagmar-gate. Initial ratcheting: sets floor to MinimumFloor on first successful gate. Full ratcheting (coverage from pod output) is a follow-up. Follow-up ticket dagmar-3772: migrate YAML checkables to Go code.

name: manifest/ as shared contract home: GateResult + meta-prompts single source of truth
description: dagmar-481f: All cross-module duplication eliminated. manifest/ module now holds: GateResult/CheckResult (gate JSON contract), meta-prompts (coder/reviewer/adjudicator-meta.md via go:embed), ProjectManifest/Checkable (existing). Both .dagmar and root modules import from manifest — no duplicated types. Root go.mod and .dagmar go.mod both require manifest v0.1.0. Internal prompts directories deleted from both root and .dagger modules.

name: Session resume 2026-08-10: Prompter-LLM pipeline, coverage ratcheting, kind cluster testing
description: ADR-0023 (Prompter-LLM) is fully implemented: pipeline prompt→code→gate→review→adjudicate. Coverage ratcheting works (GateResult JSON contract, termination-log propagation, floor ratchet). Kind cluster testing: pipeline reaches the LLM Loop but fails on --allow-llm (fixed, pushed) + LLM provider config (Secret dagger-llm-config, user creates it). Dead code cleaned: k3s spike, placeholder packages, manifest dead types. Open tickets: dagmar-e0d5 (kind cluster), dagmar-be2c (reviewer parse), dagmar-326f (shell injection), dagmar-d8dc (task-context), dagmar-3c07 (param refactor), dagmar-16fb (termination-log hardening). Also: manifest v0.2.0 needs proxy.golang.org propagation before .dagmar can import manifest types.

title: ADR-0024: Per-role LLM tool matrix
rationale: Each LLM role (prompter, coder, reviewer, adjudicator) gets a specific tool-surface enforced via WithBlockedFunction. All roles: dagmar-bootstrap+dagmar-gate blocked (gate is deterministic controller step). Read-only roles: Container.withExec blocked. Resolves ADR-0011 deferred.

title: ADR-0025: Structured agent output via WithJSONValueOutput
rationale: All agent outputs use WithJSONValueOutput (not termination-log, not LastReply). No byte limit. extractJSONOutput retries if agent doesn't set valid JSON. Enables future DSL pipelines.

name: Container-based vendor-agnostic hook pattern
description: dagmar-issues/dagmar-memory hooks build a dagger.Container with the backing CLI (sd/ml) installed and the workspace mounted. No exec.Command (fails in Dagger container). The function name is the contract (ADR-0017 §7); the backing is implementation detail.
Gate fail-open: evaluateGate defaulted gateGreen=true when gate result unreadable. Fixed to fail-closed when pod exists but result unreadable; defaults green only when no pod at all (test/dev env).
resolution: evaluateGate: gateGreen defaults true (no pod = trust Sub-Run success), but flips to false when AgentPodName is set and readGateResult fails (pod exists but unreadable = fail-closed). Review 30 E2a.

name: Dead code removal: advance* functions replaced by FSM
description: The four advance* functions (advanceCoding/Gating/Reviewing/Adjudicating) in orchestration.go were dead code after the FSM migration (ADR-0026). Removed ~208 LOC + unused helpers (readPrompterFromAnnotations, transitionPipelineFSM, validateRole, joinSpace, tools.go, unused-import hack). All dead code removed before ADR-0027 refactoring to avoid compounding.
